{{Top|leg}}
'''Thrive or Die''' was the memoir of the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known only as the [[Bloodletter]]. It tells the true tale of how the spy infiltrated the [[Bacta Cartel/Legends|Bacta Cartel]] while under the employ of the [[Ashern]], a [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] rebel group. While inspecting the [[Alazhi/Legends|Alazhi]] fields with his Vratix partner [[Seeqov Thranx]], they were ambushed and fatally wounded by a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]. The Bloodletter was shot in the face with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and was saved by Thranx using [[kolcta]], the very secret the Ashern were protecting.<ref name="bacta">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031106thyferra|text=Thyferra: Bacta Basics|int=Thyferra: Bacta Basics}}</ref>

Despite being forbidden by her superiors, Thranx trusted the Bloodletter and divulged details regarding the medicine. With the wounds healed, the Bloodletter suddenly killed Thranx by snapping the insectoid's head. It turned out that the Bloodletter was being paid more by an anonymous employer, higher than the Bacta Cartel and Ashern.<ref name="bacta" />

Within forty eight hours the Bloodletter boarded a transport back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A week later, the [[kolazhi]] fields experienced a mysterious blight except one field. The Bloodletter personally saw the harvesting of that field and delivered several tons of kolcta to the client, who claimed to be suffering from a degenerative aging disease.<ref name="bacta" />

Many years later, not long after the [[Bacta War]], the infamous [[Human/Legends|Human]] spy released the memoir ''Thrive or Die''. The following holotranscripts were read personally by Bloodletter via closed-circuit holo transmitted from an unknown location. The [[New Republic Historical Archive]] featured the document on display shortly after.<ref name="bacta" />
